items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: So I was on that committee to help him.

ctx.x: Did you get involved, even beyond the music, with the civil rights scene in Berkeley, and kind of social activism?
Well in Berkeley, well there was a thing with Bobby Seale running for the mayor of Oakland and then the recall of D’Army Bailey. I participated on both of those as a student.
I wasn’t sure what you said — a recall of—
